# Vendored NVBoard

This directory is a verbatim copy of the parts of NVBoard that the optional
`nvboard` feature builds and runs. It is not a fork: keep it identical to
upstream so the copy can be refreshed by re-copying the same paths.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/NJU-ProjectN/nvboard>
- Commit: `b5f49b68a85f4a1a185086cbd6532fff3ecda454` (2026-10-12)
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`
- Copied: `src/`, `include/`, `usr/include/`, `resources/`, `board/`,
  `LICENSE`, `README.md`
- Not copied: `example/`, `scripts/`, `NVBoard.jpg`

`src/` is compiled into `libnvboard.a` by `shyhdl` the first time the board
backend is used; `resources/` (the FreeMono font and the switch/button
pictures) is read at run time, so the board process gets `NVBOARD_HOME` pointed
at this directory. Pin bindings are generated by `shyhdl` itself
(`src/nvboard.rs`), which is why `scripts/` is not needed here.
